_comment: Link resolution contract. Ported from the Swift LinkResolver tests. Each case: given `href` clicked inside the document at `doc`, `external` is the absolute URL to hand the system browser (or null), and `resolved` is the local file path to open in the viewer (or null). A case sets exactly one of them, or both null for 'do nothing'. Paths are spelled the POSIX way because this fixture is platform-neutral; each port returns whatever separator its host OS uses, so the three test harnesses normalise separators before comparing.
